Name: QUINETHICS
Description:
Quinethics is built upon a two-pillar foundation. Spearheading Research & Development of novel medicinal compounds on one side, and manufacturing new biosynthetic and biointegrated generic drugs on the other. By generating early revenue through innovative biosynthesis of generic pharmaceutical products, Quinethics gravitates towards an organic expansion on a vector of diverse and multidisciplinary competences. 
 
The first project tackles Parkinson’s disease by focusing development on the biosynthetic process for producing the drug Levodopa. At the time of this writing, 250 ton Levodopa is consumed annually by the 8.5 million people who suffer from Parkinson’s disease worldwide. By the year 2040, these numbers are expected to double. Quinethics is pursuing a share of the Levodopa market by entering with a cutting-edge substitute that is both sustainable and cost-effective. 
 
But that is just the beginning. Through further development of biosynthetic processes, and by generating a subsequent library of derivatives, Quinethics will develop drugs intended to treat disorders where treatment is scarce. We consider the potential for drug assisted psychotherapy to be especially high, and resolve to focus our drug development projects on Breakthrough Therapies.

Name: SALSS SCIENCE4PEACE
Description:
The 2022 SALSS SCIENCE4PEACE is a special edition of the classic SALSS format as we explore the connection between Science and Peace with the long-term mission of welcoming our fellow Ukrainian colleagues into the European and American Life Science Community.

The Swedish-American Life Science Summit (SALSS) is a by-invitation-only conference bringing together some of the most renowned Life Science executives, scientists, entrepreneurs and investors. The aim is to build strategic and collaborative relationships between academia, industry and fundings, thus enhancing Life Science business. 
 
SALSS was founded in 2005 as an initiative to increase the level of cross-border business between one of the largest market in the world, the United States, and one of the most important Life Science industry centers in Europe, Sweden. Over the years the Summit has taken on an increasingly global nature, making it a true reflection of the Life Science industry today. It is our hope and ambition that SALSS will continue serving to strengthen Life Science entrepreneurship, partnership and friendship. 
 
The traditional event, held annually during three days in late August in Stockholm, presents an intense and exclusive program featuring insights from top-notch speakers, high-level panel discussions, a limited number of presentations by successful and promising companies, as well as a small and thoughtfully matched exhibit of specially selected start-up companies operating within Life Science. The Summit offers plenty of opportunity to one-to-one meetings and networking. 
 
Another important aspect of SALSS is the emphasis on women in the industry. Over the last years, the group of SALSS Women has grown remarkably. The summit continues to feature top-tier women in life science throughout our programs, and also at other events addressing our global network.

Name: Cirkulär
Description:
BASE INGREDIENTS FOR A CIRCULAR FUTURE.

At Cirkulär, we envision a waste-free future underpinned by circular solutions that utilize all biomass extracted from Earth at its maximum potential. This means not only optimizing the economic use of our natural resources but also minimizing the environmental impact on our planet.

To realize this vision, we have set ourselves an ambitious goal - to become the next global leader in circular solutions. Our mission is to extract as much sustainable value and useful service as possible out of residual lignocellulosic waste streams, transforming them from a costly problem to a valuable feedstock for multiple end-applications. 

We harness the transformative potential and natural abilities of filamentous fungi - powered by cutting-edge fermentation design and engineering principles – to unlock the inherent dormant value in lignocellulosic residual waste. 

Cirkulär's flagship solution is utilising waste streams from the Swedish pulp industry to produce CirkuleinTM - a high-quality mycomealTM rich in proteins and beta glucans with a complete amino acid profile.

At Cirkulär, we value collaboration, embrace disruption, and promote a strong sense of ownership to propel us forward in our mission to build the next global leader of circular solutions.

Name: SynAct Pharma
Description:
SynAct Pharma is a biotech company aiming at resolving inflammation by leveraging melanocortin biology. Our lead asset AP1189 is in phase 2 development for the treatment of rheumatoid arthritis. AP1189 is an immunomodulatory small molecule delivered as a once-daily tablet. The mode of action is selective melanocortin receptor type 1 and 3 agonism, making it first-in-class. Activation of these receptors results in reduced secretion of proinflammatory cytokines by neutrophils and in conversion of macrophages towards clearing away cellular debris in hyper-inflamed tissue – two effects that together induce resolution of inflammation. The Phase 2a BEGIN study in patients with rheumatoid arthritis reported very promising efficacy and safety results in November 2021 - next step is to open an IND with FDA to get advice on further development. 
Due to the known Mode of Action, then AP1189 was also tested in COVID-19 positive patients with respiratory insufficiency. Results were reported in July 2021, demonstrating 4 days earlier respiratory recovery, 3 days earlier hospital discharge and more than 50% reduced risk of progressing to needing mechanical ventilation.

Name: SciLifeLab Gothenburg
Description:
SciLifeLab is a Swedish national center for molecular biosciences with focus on health and environmental research. The center combines frontline technical expertise with advanced knowledge of translational medicine and molecular bioscience.
SciLifeLab was established in 2010 and appointed a national center in 2013 by the Swedish government. Four additional sites - Lund, Gothenburg, Linköping and Umeå - were appointed in 2021 in addition to the original two in Stockholm and Uppsala.
The SciLifelab site in Gothenburg includes units at both the University of Gothenburg and Chalmers University of Technology and has a strong connection to Sahlgrenska University Hospital. These units are Bioinformatics (NBIS), Centre for Cellular Imaging (with focus on Cryo-EM and Correlative Array Tomography), Clinical Genomics, Chemical Biology Consortium Sweden, OligoNova Hub, Proteomics Core Facility (with focus on Glycoproteomics), Swedish Metabolomics Center and Swedish NMR center.

Name: Ironic Biotech
Description:
1 in 3 women worldwide live with iron deficiency.

Fatigue. Brain fog. Heart palpitations. Depression. Learning disabilities. A condition that silently holds women back, at school, at work, throughout life. Menstruation, pregnancy, and childbirth mean women lose more iron than men, consistently, across their entire lives.

Yet the solutions available today are failing them.

Oral supplements don't work: 60% of women quit due to gastrointestinal side effects like constipation and stomach pain.
IV infusions are costly: effective, but invasive, time-consuming, and expensive, costing up to $3,000 per treatment.

At Ironic Biotech, we've developed BiohemeTM, a patented animal-free heme iron protein that biomimics the heme iron found in meat, delivering the world's most bioavailable form of iron.

Tasteless and stable, our iron works as a daily supplement or can be added directly into food, making it easy to integrate into real life.

Name: Print4Life
Description:

Supported by the Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions programme, the Print4Life project trains early-stage researchers to master this disruptive technology, focusing on sustainable, patient-specific solutions for healthcare. Through hands-on research, industry secondments, and interdisciplinary training, participants will explore biodegradable, antibacterial materials (Mg- and Zn-alloys and advanced bioinks) and 3D cell-containing models to address challenges like antimicrobial resistance. Additionally, it equips researchers with entrepreneurial and regulatory know-how, preparing them for careers in academia, industry, and policy. With its strong emphasis on innovation and sustainability, Print4Life builds a new generation of experts ready to advance biomedical science.

This project has received funding from the European Union’s Horizon MSCA DN 2024 grant agreement, no. 101226431.

- Simultaneous Indel Profiling: Profile and validate hundreds of genomic loci in a single reaction.

Vi har ett brett produktsortiment med många välkända tillverkare. Vår ambition är att ständigt utveckla och förfina vår befintliga produktportfölj samt hitta kompletterande produkter för att bidra till utveckling och framåtskridande hos våra kunder inom forskning, diagnostik och produktion.

Exempel på områden där vi är ledande är transfusion, cellodling, mikrobiologisk provtagning för diagnostik såväl som kontroll av produktionsmiljöer, och molekylärbiologi. Vi har även en väl utvecklad serviceavdelning för att serva våra instrument samt ett pipettkalibreringslab, PipettdoktornTM.

Nordic Biolabs är kvalitetscertifierat enligt ISO 9001 och miljöcertifierat enligt ISO 14001. Just kvalitetsarbetet har en central roll och grunden för kvalitet är att arbeta med ständiga förbättringar.

Vi är totalt 28 anställda. Genom att internt, och tillsammans med våra leverantörer, utbilda oss inom de områden vi är verksamma i och på våra produkter ger vi dig som kund den support som alltid förväntas av en bra leverantör.

Name: Spago Nanomedical AB
Description:
Spago Nanomedical is a Swedish biotechnology company developing products for precision imaging and radionuclide treatment of cancer and other devastating diseases. The company ́s two main development programs,  SpagoPix and Tumorad, are based on a unique and proprietary platform for physiological accumulation of optimized and functionalized polymeric particles in tumors.

Candidate drug SN132D is a gadolinium-free contrast agent for precision magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) with exceptionally high signal strength. By selective physiological accumulation in tumor tissue, SpagoPix meets a well recognized need for significantly improved soft tissue tumor imaging with further potential in inflammatory endometriosis.

Candidate drug 177Lu-SN201 is a novel radiopharmaceutical nanoprticle with potential to expand the scope of radionuclide therapy in solid tumor indications not currently targetable by other modalities, as monotherapy or in combinations with established treatments.

Name: CubaseBio
Description:
CubaseBio is a Stockholm-based spatial biology company, founded by innovators in science and technology to build tools that reveal biology in three dimensions.

Our solution enables true 3D spatial analysis at scale, unlocking unprecedented biological insights and accelerating drug discovery.

Name: Offspring Biosciences AB
Description:
Offspring Biosciences is the Tissue-First Translational Partner for pharma scientists. We were founded to address the critical and potentially costly failure to address ‘Translational Gap’ in antibody development by moving beyond preclinical models and validating candidates in the only environment that matters: human disease tissue. We deliver decisive, quantitative insights with years of contextual experience that provide valuable 'go/no-go' confidence before the clinic.

          The Mouse was Cured. The Patient Wasn't.
 
Over 90% of antibody candidates that look promising in animal models ultimately fail in human trials, victims to the 'Translational Gap'.  
At Offspring Biosciences, we can help you bridge that gap.  
Our proprietary Tissue-InsightsTM platform moves beyond subjective scoring to deliver Digital Truth. We answer not just if a drug binds, but where, how, and if it matters within the specific context of the human disease microenvironment. We transform ambiguous images into objective, AI-driven statistical datasets—turning 'Pixels into P-Values.'

We combine the speed and flexibility of a boutique lab with the deep, pharma-grade expertise of the scientists who run it, allowing us to act as a true extension of your team.  This helps us provide the responsive, scientific partnership required to solve complex translational problems.

Our platform is proven. We are proud to have provided the key translational data that supported BioArctic's successful advancement of multiple ADPD therapeutics, proving its selective binding in human PArkinson's and Alzheimer's brain tissue.

Stop guessing. Start validating with a partner that delivers clarity.

Name: Biomedsphere
Description:
We will promote you or your product and bring opportunities for your growth plans. Whether you are a researcher, research institute, or a company and want to gain growth. 

We will engage your content or career related updates anything that you want to share with public. We will share them on our page (citing your name), and spread your words to audience so that they reach you. 
Follow our page: 
https://lnkd.in/dPiTVSX

Name: pixlbio (formerly Phenaros)
Description:
pixlbio is redefining predictive biology.

Formed from the merger of DefiniGEN (UK) and Phenaros (Sweden), we combine iPSC-derived human models with high-throughput imaging and AI-powered phenomics to uncover subtle cellular insights that animal models can’t.

Our platform captures millions of images and profiles hundreds of millions of cells each week, turning complex biology into predictive clarity for drug discovery and safety.

What we offer:
- iPSC-derived hepatocytes, stellates & intestinal organoids
- Validated disease models (MASLD/MASH, A1ATD, Wilson’s)
- AI-driven phenomics
- Proprietary automation and SaaS access

Trusted by 11 of the top 20 pharma companies, leading biotechs, and research institutions worldwide.

We’re ISO 9001:2015 certified and expanding into cardiac and renal models — building the next generation of predictive biology.

 Every cell tells a story. Every pixel holds a clue.

Name: Akiram Therapeutics
Description:
Akiram Therapeutics is a Swedish biotech company committed to developing innovative and targeted molecular radiotherapy for patients with incurable cancer. Our product combines a radiation component with a proprietary antibody to deliver radioactivity directly to cancer cells while minimizing damage to surrounding healthy tissues. Our research is based on cutting-edge discoveries made at Uppsala University, and our team is composed of experts in radiation sciences, cancer precision medicine, and drug development. 

At Akiram, our mission is to make targeted molecular radiotherapy widely accessible to cancer patients. We recognize that each patient's cancer is unique and requires a personalized approach to treatment. By utilizing state-of-the-art radiopharmaceuticals and precision medicine, we aim to create more effective and personalized treatments for people fighting cancer.

Name: In vitro Plant-tech AB
Description:
Developed by Science with Compassion for Nature

Imagine a world where the synthesis of bioactive compounds is tailored, more efficient, and more sustainable than ever before. At In vitro Plant-tech, we are making this a reality with our advanced metabolic enhancement platform, where the power of plant cell technology is combined with precise targeting and production of selected actives. This enables production of highly active botanical ingredients (HABI), standardised to concentration and activity. Join us in redefining the active ingredients landscape with nature’s finest offerings and innovative technology.

Name: Lucero Bio
Description:
We are a bioconvergence company that weds synergistic technologies from the fields of microbiology, AI, and microfluidics. 

Our solution aims to tackle key challenges surrounding 3D-cell-culture handling, miniaturization, and assay preparation.

Lucero’s platform will enable pharmaceutical companies to reliably use 3D cell cultures at scale to make faster pipeline decisions and accelerate promising candidates to the clinic.

Name: AdBIOPRO, Competence Centre for Advanced Bioproduction
Description:
AdBIOPRO is the Competence Centre for Advanced BioProduction. Under the direction of Professor Veronique Chotteau at KTH Royal Institute of Technology, AdBIOPRO started in 2017 and has now in 2023 been granted continuation for a new period of 5 years by Vinnova with a total budget of 112 mkr. This highly multi-disciplinary Centre gathers eight academic groups from KTH Royal Institute of Technology, Lund University, Karolinska Hospital, Karolinska Institutet and Linköping University, as well as 16 industrial partners. The industry partners are Alfa Laval, ArgusEye, BioInvent International, BioLamina, CCRM Nordic, Cellcolabs, Cellevate, Cytiva, Erbi Biosystems, a company of Merck KGaA Darmstadt Germany, Magic Bioprocessing, Metenova, a company of Repligen, NorthX Biologics, Nyctea Technologies, Servier, Timegate Instruments, and Valneva.

A panel of international experts and generalists have evaluated the work of AdBIOPRO  with concluding statements such as:

AdBIOPRO is designed to build a foundation for an important Pharma 4.0 area for integrated and continuous bioproduction. This field is of strategic importance for the industry.

The high-quality science, education and competence sharing of AdBIOPRO are very relevant for the Swedish industry and its international competitiveness and for the society at large (patients, health system) as it facilitates new biopharmaceuticals, produced more economically and more sustainably.

AdBIOPRO is one of the very few academic centres in the world focusing on continuous bioproduction, and probably the only one with such broadness of scope and collaborations. The Centre has developed collaborations nationally and internationally as shown by the number of contacts established with top academic institutions and many companies in Sweden and abroad.

Visit our youtube channel for Tutorials 
https://youtube.com/@adbiopro

Name: PharmNovo
Description:
PharmNovo AB is a clinical-stage pharmaceutical company focused on developing safe and effective drugs for neuropathic pain. In this area, there is currently a lack of sufficient treatments. The company’s drug candidate, PN6047, effectively reduces neuropathic pain in animal models and the findings from the Phase I trial show that PN6047 is safe and well-tolerated at the doses tested, with no serious adverse events reported. Furthermore, PN6047 exhibited none of the adverse events typically associated with the conventional opioids like oxycodone and morphine, such as respiratory depression, constipation, itching, or signs of abuse potential. This validates the unique preclinical profile of PN6047, which shows that it acts extremely selectively on the delta opioid receptor distinguishing it fundamentally from conventional opioids that target the mu opioid receptor.

PN6047 is Phase II ready!

Name: Anyo Labs
Description:
ANYO Labs is focused on virtual screening and de novo small molecular drug generation in early-stage drug discovery projects. The unparalleled computational efficiency of our predictions opens up avenues never explored before allowing for data efficient and cost efficient hit identification. 
Supporting modules help aid hit-to-lead and lead optimization, while the PPI module can find correlations between hundreds of proteins simultaneously. 

Get in touch! We are open to discussing your potential projects, collaborations, or discuss any questions you might have.

Name: Neural Bionics Lab
Description: The Neural Bionics Lab aims to combine neuroengineering, in-silico modeling fro neuroprosthetics and brain-computer interfaces to address unmet clinical needs. The overall scientific goal is to investigate how the natural human sensorimotor system is encoding relevant information for expressing flexible behavior and to create models able to unveil the underlying neural mechanisms. The overall biomedical goal is to engineer neuroprosthetic devices leveraging how understanding of the natural biological system in order to improve the medical condition of people with neurological impairments.

Name: Pharem/Zymatic
Description: Pharem Biotech uses its broad biotechnology expertise to develop innovative enzymatic products that provide an effective way of removing organic pollutants in water environments. The products are specifically developed to meet customer needs of a simple and efficient solution to tackle serious environmental challanges within their scope of operation.

Name: rAAVen Therapeutics
Description: Developing state-of-the-art AAV vectors for gene therapy

Name: Spiber Technologies AB
Description:
Spiber Technologies uses recombinant technology for producing advanced biomaterials. Our primary goal is to develop and commercialize state-of-the-art patented technologies based on the recombinant spider silk protein SpiberTM and the solubility tag SolvNTTM 

SpiberTM-based products can be used as 3D scaffold for culturing stem cells and creating future Regenerative Medicine applications.

SolvNTTM can increase solubility for recombinant production of peptides and proteins.

The company was founded in 2008. The technologies are based on the successful research on spider silk conducted at the Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU), the Royal Institute of Technology (KTH) and Karolinska Institutet (KI). The company is privately owned and located in Stockholm, Sweden.

Name: HAGA.BIO
Description:
HAGA Bioscience is a spatial transcriptomics company focused where it truly matters. 
Its technology enables scalable RNA biomarkers validation across large cohorts, bridging discovery and validation through high-sensitivity in situ RNA detection at single nucleotide resolution.

Name: ImmuneBiotech AB
Description:
ImmuneBiotech AB - a microbiome company uniquely placed to develop therapeutically effective probiotic products designed using scientific and pharmacologic methods. 

Our products are scientifically designed combinations of safe probiotic strains. We have a technology platform to select and combine lactobacilli strains to have impact on important pathological alterations, such as: gut microbial dysbiosis, intestinal permeability and mucosal/systemic inflammation. We have access to a library of 150 unique probiotic strains as a base for designing powerful probiotic products.

GutMagnific
GutMagnific is our first product, scientifically designed for Irritable Bowel Syndrome (IBS) with market launch as a food supplement in 2019. GutMagnific is a patented multi-strain combination of probiotic lactobacilli strains.
GutMagnific(R) is expected to be effective on several gut related symptoms including IBS, Myalgic Encephalomyelitis also called Chronic Fatigue Syndrome (ME/CFS), and Clostridium difficile infection (CDI).
GutMagnific is the only multi-targeted probiotic product designed to address the three most important hallmarks underlying biological mechanisms of these indications.

Try it now at www.GutMagnific.com

Name: QuTEM
Description: QuTEM is a world-leading provider of GMP-certified TEM-services and quality control analyses of nanoparticles, based in Stockholm, Sweden. Our dedicated team of experts work in close partnership with our clients to provide analysis solutions and support. With nearly two decades of industry experience, a profound proficiency in interdisciplinary sciences, and an unwavering commitment to excellence, we proudly stand as the premier choice in providing TEM services. Using latest generation instruments together with Gridsee, our proprietary software developed in house tuned for image analysis, we developed validated methodologies to ensure the delivery of high-quality services and reliable data to our clients.

Name: Carbiotix
Description:
Carbiotix is an award-winning biotechnology company pioneering the onsite upcycling of plant-based side-streams.

Carbiotix mission is to improve the health of people by increasing the consumption of prebiotics and other active ingredients from upcycled side-streams. Carbiotix offers one core service today called NutraCycle, an on-site upcycling and fortification service allowing food & beverage, ingredient, and feed producers to turn plant-based products into healthier, more profitable, and sustainable products.

Name: Ecohelix
Description: Ecohelix is a Stockholm based biotech company currently scaling up a proprietary biopolymer processing technology towards production. At Ecohelix, we are confident that a large quantity of chemicals and materials can in be manufactured sustainably from forestry based raw materials. Our partnering mills has the raw material and we have the technology to make this vision a reality. We can help make packaging, cosmetics and house care more sustainable with our Woodmer products.

Name: The Swedish BioFINDER study
Description: The BioFINDER studies are independent and non-overlapping studies that have been initiated with the overarching aims to discover key mechanisms in Alzheimer’s disease, Parkinson’s disease and other neurodegenerative disorders. These studies are designed to develop early and accurate diagnostic tests, identify novel treatment targets and help to understand the links between different pathologies and clinical symptoms.

Name: Cyxone
Description: Cyxone AB is a clinical biotech company with a portfolio of immunomodulating drugs for the treatment of autoimmune diseases such as multiple sclerosis (MS) and rheumatoid arthritis (RA). Cyxone’s technologies have the potential to address an unmet need to develop new effective and safe medicines that can improve the quality of life for patients affected by autoimmune diseases. The company’s development portfolio comprises rabeximod in a clinical phase II program for RA and T20K that has successfully completed phase I infusion study for MS.

Name: Shimadzu Sverige
Description: Välkommen till Shimadzu Sverige! Här hittar du information om vårt breda sortiment av analytiska instrument och mjukvarulösningar, speciellt designade för att göra livet på labb lite enklare. Shimadzu erbjuder produkter för både det stora och lilla labbet, oavsett om du jobbar med livsmedel, jordbruk, läkemedel, miljö, petrokemi, biobränsle, energi, polymerer eller inom akademin så kan vi hjälpa dig. Och kanske det allra bästa är vår support, som börjar med att vi hjälper dig att hitta rätt instrument och konfigurering, anpassat efter ditt behov, och slutar den dagen du inte har några fler frågor. Vi har bland annat gaskromatografi (GC), gaskromatografi-masspektrometri (GCMS), vätskekromatografi (LC, HPLC, UHPLC), vätskekromatografi-masspektrometri (LCMS), ultrasnabb masspektrometri (UFMS), spektroskopi, UV-Vis-NIR, FTIR, atomabsorptionsspektroskopi (AAS) och energidispersiv röntgenfluorescensspektrometri, emissionsspektroskopi med induktivt kopplad plasma (ICP-OES), system för grundämnes- och ytanalys, partikelstorlek, laboratorieinstrument för biovetenskap, analys av totalt organiskt kol, materialtest-instrument. Självklart har vi även mjukvarulösningar och färdiga metodpaket!

Name: Simply No Waste
Description: The growing population need to be fed while we reduce environmental impact and we are here to contribute to that using modern technologies im circular model.

Name: BOHUS Biotech
Description:
We are Scandinavian HA.
Here from the start, at the heart of the Hyaluronic Acid revolution, HA is not only in our roots, it’s in our DNA.
Facing the clear waters of the North Sea and the Atlantic Ocean stands Strömstad, a beautiful small town in western Sweden, our home for over thirty years. One of the first companies in the world to explore the water-binding qualities of hyaluronic acid, BOHUS continues to lead innovation and development of products containing HA for medical and aesthetic purposes. HA is in our foundation. It’s in our DNA.

We have served our partners and customers in ophthalmics, orthopaedics and aesthetics for decades. Our deep production expertise and technological know-how are the foundations upon which we have built one of Europe’s leading developers and manufacturers of high-quality hyaluronic acid products.

BOHUS products are used in aesthetic enhancement, skin care, cataract surgery and the treatment of osteoarthritis. With a large and growing network of international partners, we sell to hospitals, clinics and physicians in over 60 markets worldwide.

Our vision is to revolutionise the market by delivering higher quality products, with the most sustainable processes, at exceptional value.

Name: LayerLogic AB
Description:
Our portable sensor, powered by graphene field effect transistors, delivers rapid, sensitive detection of various substances.

We are combining the latest discoveries in nanotechnology with advanced microbiology creating a precise and reliable biosensor that gives answer within minutes. 

A start-up sprung from Chalmers University of Technology, based on a fruitful collaboration between the two research groups led by Prof. Avgust Yurgens at the department of Microtechnology and Nanoscience, and Prof. Ivan Mijakovic at the division of Systems and Synthetic Biology.

Name: Miris AB
Description:
Miris is a MedTech Swedish company developing and selling instrument and solutions for human milk analysis. The company was established in 2001 focusing on te application of analysing dairy milk. In 2006 Miris launched it's first instrumnet for human milk analysis as the field of individual nutrition of preterm babies became a standard in the neonatal intensive care units in Sweden. Since then, the company has built unique compentence and expertise in this field.  We market and distribute the product portfolio for Miris HMA - Human Milk Analyzer (HMA) containing a complete set of services and consumables. HMA is measuring energy, fat, carbohydrates and protein content in human milk within minutes using a small sample volume.
The HMA is used both for clinically and for research to analyse breast milk, enabeling individual nutrition of preterm babies. Strategicly Miris is focusing on how to develop and serve neonatal care related to nutrition. Miris have world-wide representation and today, HMA together with the Miris Ultrasonic Processor and Miris Heater for sample preparation, is sold in more than 25 countries. 

We envision a future where every child is born with the same access to healthcare, ensuring the best possible start in life. Our mission is to make individual nutrition, based on breast milk, available globally to improve neonatal health. Through our expertise and solutions we increase awareness, support researchers and enable doctors to individualize breast milk fortification.

Name: Seaqure labs
Description: Seaqure labs is a Swedish Biotech startup that develop mycelium-based ingredients for animal feed solutions. By utilizing fungi, our technology allow us to create a fully circular ingredient product using agri-food sidestreams, powered by the circular economy.

Name: Xpress Genomics
Description: Xpress Genomics delivers fast, high-quality, and cost-effective next-generation sequencing (NGS) solutions to accelerate discoveries in oncology, neurology, immunology, and beyond. Our services range from sequencing of ready-made libraries and whole-genome sequencing to bulk RNA-sequencing and state-of-the-art single-cell and spatial technologies. Building on our deep expertise in single-cell genomics, we have developed Xpress-seq, a proprietary method that uniquely combines high throughput with full-length transcript coverage, enabling more comprehensive single cell insights at scale. Headquartered in Stockholm and serving clients worldwide, spanning pharmaceutical companies, academic research and  biotech, Xpress Genomics empowers scientists to advance biomedical research and discoveries.

Name: AquaFood AB
Description:
Our food system as a species is a major driver of climate change. It accounts for 33% of all greenhouse gas emissions, a third of global land usage, and two-thirds of groundwater withdrawal. In seafood production, the amount of raw material escaping the food chain goes remarkably above the average where as much as 50-70% of the raw material entering the fish filleting and shrimp peeling industries is not made into food. All while the oceans and aquaculture cannot cope with the fast-growing demand for seafood and sustainable proteins.

We believe that resource efficiency is the key solution to fulfilling the growing demand without imposing more pressure on our ecosystems or increasing our carbon footprint. 

Through the use of our technology, seafood producers can upcycle their sidestreams to food-grade protein and omega-3 rich oil. Our method provides intact protein chains, in high yields, which retain their product-forming capabilities and can therefore easily be made into various different end-products. Therefore, we believe our solution can cut down on low-value uses of side streams and rather maintain them in the food chain which is a great advantage from both a sustainability aspect as well as an economical one. In addition; more food from each fish can reduce overfishing.

Name: Swedish Longevity Cluster
Description:
For those who want to seize the immense value of longevity, the longevity cluster provides a platform for industrial co-operation and innovation.

We unlock massive value by building joint missions fed by thought-leadership, strategic insights, and networks.

This is one of the clusters at Epicenter Stockholm.

Name: SHIELD Doctoral Network
Description:
SHIELD (Strategies for Healing Implant-associated infections and Enhancing Longevity in Devices) is a prestigious EU-funded Doctoral Network dedicated to advancing the management of implant-related infections. It provides a unique interdisciplinary platform for 16 talented early-career researchers to pursue their PhDs across 26 institutions in 11 countries, including universities and industry partners in Europe, Switzerland, and the US. 

Focusing on innovative approaches in regenerative medicine, biomaterials, and translational research, SHIELD aims to develop cutting-edge solutions that improve patient outcomes and extend the longevity of medical devices through collaboration across orthopedics, otology, and odontology.

Name: Coegin Pharma AB
Description:
We are a Swedish innovation company developing and commercializing advanced cosmetic technologies for hair and skin. Our flagship innovation, Follicopeptide, is a patented, clinically developed peptide technology targeting hair thinning. It is currently being introduced globally through selected partners and our own brand VEXIENNE. In parallel, we are developing NPP-4, a next-generation cosmetic peptide innovation designed to enhance skin tone  without UV exposure or chemicals.

With scalable in-house production, established intellectual property, and a flexible commercial model, we are positioned to bring differentiated, science-based products to the global cosmetics market.

Our share is listed on NGM Growth Market and dual-listed on Börse Stuttgart.

Name: Omnio AB
Description: Omnio AB is a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to revolutionizing the treatment of diabetic foot ulcers (DFUs) through the development of recombinant plasminogen therapeutics.

Name: Biofrigas Sweden AB (Publ.)
Description: Småskaliga anläggningar för produktion av flytande biogas (LBG).

Name: Wieslab, a Svar Life Science company
Description:
Wieslab Diagnostic Services is a contract laboratory providing high-quality, fast laboratory services and clinical diagnostic testing to clinicians and laboratories worldwide. Wieslab Laboratory Services is a part of Svar Life Science, Located in Malmö, Sweden.

Wieslab Diagnostic Services focuses on providing high-quality, fast laboratory services to customers worldwide- committed to providing answers to your needs. 

One of the great advantages of outsourcing laboratory specialty testing is the time and resources it saves your laboratory. That's why our goal is to always develop and apply the best analytical technologies for clinical research and establish practical platforms for routine diagnosis.

Offering one of the widest-ranging autoimmune testing services available
Wieslab offers a comprehensive range of esoteric clinical diagnostic tests within neuro-immunology, nephrology, rheumatology, and gastroenterology. Wieslab strives to be at the forefront of autoimmunity testing. Therefore, we constantly update our test portfolio by continuously evaluating, developing, and validating new testing services.

Name: BioGaia LATAM
Description: BioGaia es una compañía innovadora sueca de atención médica que se ha posicionado como líder mundial en suplementos alimenticios con probióticos durante casi 30 años. A lo largo de los años, hemos creado redes de investigadores y especialistas líderes e independientes, expertos en manufactura y socios locales de distribución en todo el mundo. Nuestros productos son recomendados por pediatras y otros profesionales de la salud en más de 100 países.

Name: Guard Therapeutics
Description:
Guard Therapeutics completed the acquisition of Disruptive Pharma through a reverse takeover in July 2026. Following completion of the transaction, the listed company will change its name to Disruptive Pharma AB (publ). 
This LinkedIn page is retained for historical information and is no longer actively updated. 
For current company information, news and updates, please follow Disruptive Pharma: https://www.linkedin.com/company/disruptive-pharma-ab/

Name: Norbite
Description:
Norbite transforms plastic waste into sustainable goods by means of an insect-based biorefinery.

The selected insect, Galleria mellonella, possess the extraordinary capacity to naturally digests plastic. Norbite took advantage of this feeding specificity of G. mellonella and has developed a proprietary vertical farming technology to enable the insects to perform at industrial scale. 
To produce sustainable goods, thus obtained larvae are bio-refined to get proteins, for food and feed; antimicrobial peptides (AMPs) - to fight multidrug resistant bacteria (MDR); elicitors – to reinforce natural plants’ defences and avoid the utilisation of pesticides; and even the dejections of the insects are used as biofertilizers, making this process a perfect example of circular economy.

Name: Cline Scientific
Description:
Cline Scientific develops and markets innovative tools for Life Science research based on nanotechnology.

The product portfolio consists of Nano Gradients, Nano Surfaces and Nano Particles, all used for precise studies in biomedical applications.

Cline Scientific is Scandinava ́s only producer and developer of engineered gold nanoparticles

www.ClineScientific.com

http://news.cision.com/se/cline

Name: MetaboGen AB
Description: As a pioneering company addressing the microbiome to understand health and disease, MetaboGen is creating breakthrough opportunities to develop novel therapeutics and next generation probiotics. The company was founded based on world leading science from the labs of Professor Fredrik Bäckhed and Professor Jens B Nielsen, to provide commercial access to metagenome research and development. MetaboGen has built a platform that integrates top-of-the line metagenomic data analysis with strain identification and subsequent development as well as clinical programs, to ensure successful development of novel assets.

Name: IVRS AB
Description:
IVRS is an innovative preclinical CRO dedicated to accelerating drug discovery and validation for severe human diseases with significant unmet medical needs. Our expertise spans both in vitro and in vivo studies, helping to fast-track the development of breakthrough therapies.

We specialize in advanced animal models for cancer, neurodegenerative diseases, and inflammatory disorders, providing:

- Precise characterization of disease progression
- Continuous monitoring of drug efficacy with high-throughput approaches
- Visual tracking of biodistribution throughout the body and targeted organs
- PK/PD profiling to optimize candidate drug performance

At IVRS, our state-of-the-art technologies and disease models ensure your drug pipeline advances with accuracy and efficiency. Let us support your journey to delivering life-changing treatments.

Name: Oxcia AB (publ)
Description: Oxcia AB is a pioneer in oxidative DNA damage and DNA Damage Response (DDR – the body’s way of repairing the damage that occurs to DNA). The two most advanced projects emanating from the O2-DDR technology platform are OXC-101 for cancer and OXC-201 for pulmonary fibrosis. The portfolio also includes exploratory projects, e.g. in psoriasis and non-disclosed discovery projects.

Name: WntResearch AB
Description:
WntResearch is developing a completely new type of cancer drug that inhibits the ability of tumour cells to spread in the body and form metastases. The company's research is focused on studying the endogenous protein WNT5A, which in scientific studies has shown to affect tumour cells' ability to move and spread in the body. WntResearch drug candidate Foxy-5 is a peptide that mimics the function of WNT5A and is intended to reduce the mobility and spread of cancer cells thus preventing metastases from occurring. Although current cancer treatment has become more effective, there are no effective ways to prevent the onset of metastases that cause about 90 per cent of all cancerrelated deaths. Foxy-5 has a unique mechanism of action and has shown a good safety profile with few side effects in two Phase I clinical trials. The safety and efficacy of Foxy-5 are now being evaluated in the ongoing Phase 2 clinical trial NeoFox, in patients with stage II-III colon cancer.
WntResearch is listed on the Spotlight Stock Market. For more information, please visit: www.wntresearch.com.

Name: SVF Vaccines AB
Description:
SVF is developing a novel platform for vaccines and imunnetherapies that could be administrated as DNA, proteinbased or RNA.  
Our first candidates targets disease areas with a high unmet medical need Hepatitis B(HBV), Hepatitis D(HDV) and corona viruses with targeted indications: 
HDV therapeutic vaccine
HDV prophylactic vaccine
HBV therapeutic vaccine
Corona viruss prophylactic vaccine 

HDV: Aprox 12M carriers worldwide and increasing prevalence in the EU, 3-5% prevalence among HBV carriers and >15% in HBV patients visiting specialist clinics. Main course to cirrhosis and liver cancer. No preventive vaccine available and very limited treatment options. Potential as Orphan drug and fast track designation. Significant commercial potenital

HBV: Huge population (300M), even small at-high-risk segments have significant commercial potential. Targeting patients already under care on existing treatments. Untreated HBV causes cirrhosis and liver cancer with high costs for patients as well as health care

coronavirus: ongoing pandemic with a high unmet need. SVF strategy is to make the vaccine future proof towards other coronaviruses than Sars-Cov2 

SVF has experienced expertise of top researchers on viral hepatitis vaccines and immunotherapies and a strong track record of launching several” first in class” drugs at big pharma companies in its team. 
If you have any questions, please contact us:
Jens Bäck
Mail: jens@vaccinfabriken.se
cell:+46730852339

Name: Nidacon International AB
Description:
Nidacon, a Swedish company headquartered in Gothenburg, manufactures and markets medical devices, mainly for Assisted Reproduction Technologies (ART), with IVF, ICSI, artificial insemination (IUI) and vitrification solutions.
NidaCon continually strives to improve the outcome of ART, with more pregnancies, by developing superior media systems for clinics, patients and the animal breeding industry.

Name: Aptahem
Description: Aptahem AB is a biotechnology company that develops aptamer-based pharmaceuticals for the treatment of life-threatening conditions in which a combination of coagulation and inflammation are involved. The company’s primary pharmaceutical candidate, Apta-1, is being developed with the aim of preventing the high mortality rate caused by organ and tissue damage in patients diagnosed with a septic condition, among others. The company holds patent protection in strategic target markets and actively seeks business development opportunities with potential collaborators.

Name: BioServices AB
Description:

Name: Voon Innovation AB
Description:
Voon Innovation’s origin came out from a discussion at a dinner at the restaurant Miss Voon in Stockholm June 25th 2020. The people that met had long experience working in the snus industry and the Cannabis industry both in the US and Europe. The topic of the discussion was – “is it possible to make a great smokeless Cannabis alternative in form of a snus”? 

The answer is not simple – Water solubility and lipophilicity (fat solubility) are key factors determining drug absorption, the drug must be soluble in the body fluids at the site of absorption and also be enough lipophilic to cross biological membranes.
Traditional snus is a form of smokeless tobacco inside a pouch that is placed under your upper lip. The active component nicotine easily crosses the mucous membranes in the mouth and is quickly absorbed by the blood stream. 
The active components of cannabis (THC, CBD, CBG, etc.) on the other hand, do not dissolve in water due to its oily nature and are therefore not easily absorbed by the body. 

Our idea was to combine our knowledge from the snus and Cannabis industry with novel formulation technology to find a solution. Our goal was to create a highly intelligent product that not only delivers superior absorption capabilities but also solves the formulation challenges coupled with hemp oil and isolates. Several months of creative meetings and solid experimental research eventually resulted in a natural and safe formulation containing CBD inside a pouch. 

We can now present a novel nanotechnology-based formulation which we call ACDS (Alternative Cannabis Delivery System). The system gives a higher and faster bioavailability and maybe more importantly, a better consumer experience. 

Voon will continue striving for improved smokeless Cannabis products for our consumers. Our products are free from tobacco or nicotine, gluten and of course vegan proof.

Name: PhyNexus now part of Biotage

We provide life science researchers the solution to high throughput sample processing in drug discovery, screening, structural work, and any process where very high concentrations of very pure product are desired and where it is important that the biological molecule remains undamaged and active. PhyTip columns can be used for purification from culture and modifying reactions, expression analysis, immunogenicity screening, CoIP, IP, and ChIP, target immobilization, buffer exchange, glycosylation analysis, process development and biofunctional assays. The PhyTip platform enables chromatography for up to 96 samples in parallel. A wide range of sample sizes can be processed from a broad selection of column bed sizes and chemistries, including affinity, ion exchange, gel filtration, normal phase and reverse phase.

PhyNexus columns used with our proprietary Dual Flow Chromatography  provide complete antibody binding for highly concentrated sample recovery from small samples and can be used in all major 8, 12 or 96 column robotic liquid handling systems.

Phytip columns can be used automated 96 at-a-time mini and midi plasmid preps.  PhyNexus provides instruments and columns for automated maxi, mega and giga plasmid preps. 

PhyTips are compatible with all major robotic systems including Agilent, Beckman, Perkin Elmer/Caliper, Dynamic Devices and Hamilton robotic systems, and Tecan. We provide the total solution including scripts, robotic set up, installation, and support. For customers desiring automation with limited budgets and bench space, we can provide our own bench top MEA and MMG systems.

PhyNexus Automation. Faster Research. Better Research.

Celluminova is a life science startup company specializing in identification of cancer stem cells. Our first indication is for malignant gliomas (aggressive brain tumors).
 
THE GLIOMA STEM CELL PROBLEM
Glioma stem cells are believed to be major drivers of tumor recurrence and are resistant to chemotherapy and radiation. Currently, no methods exist to identify or target these cells in patients. 

OUR SOLUTION
Celluminova has developed a molecule specifically targeting glioma stem cells. OUR COMMITMENT

Name: Rosenberger Lab
Description:
The Proteome of Metabolism Group is led by Assistant Professor Florian Rosenberger and was established in 2025 at Karolinska Institutet in Sweden. The lab is part of the Department of Medical Biochemistry and Biophysics and is a member of the Division of Molecular Metabolism at KI.

Research Focus
We study mitochondrial metabolism across the diverse cell types of the human body, exploring how metabolic networks differ from one tissue to the next in health and disease. Our particular focus is mitochondrial disease and the puzzle of tissue specificity: understanding why genetic defects in ubiquitous metabolic pathways lead to symptoms in only certain organs.

Clinical Collaboration
We are working to transform how mitochondrial disorders are diagnosed. By connecting proteomic signatures to clinical phenotypes, we aim to move beyond traditional approaches and enable more precise diagnosis. Our goal is to bridge the gap between cutting-edge proteomics and real clinical benefit for patients with metabolic disease.

Methods & Technology
Our work lies at the intersection of spatial and single-cell proteomics. We develop new methods for single-cell analysis, including improved sample preparation and chromatography workflows to enable high-throughput studies. Through Deep Visual Proteomics (DVP), we add a spatial dimension by combining laser microdissection with mass spectrometry to analyze proteomes at single-cell resolution while preserving tissue context.

Mission
Our core goal is to translate proteomics insights into clinical impact. By integrating advanced proteomic technologies with clinical data, we aim to improve disease diagnosis and prognosis and to support clinical management strategies for metabolic and mitochondrial disorders.

*Process control and modelling of continuous downstream processes
*Miniaturization, scale-up and scale-down of continuous downstream processes
*Process design and development of integrated continuous downstream processes

With this product profile BSG005 will fill the need for a product that offers fungicidal efficacy against a broad range of fungal strains.  BSG005 appears to be without the gaps due to resistance development seen in other antifungals. Most importantly, in the GLP-tox tests and in recognized animal models it lacks the severe kidney toxicity seen with Amphotericin B formulations. BSG005 has also shown effect against resistant fungal strains and strains that have been difficult to treat with the drugs available on the market.

SCIENCE FROM NATURE: FOR A STRONG GUT BARRIER

Nordic Rebalance is a Danish-Swedish company with more than 15 years of experience in postbiotics. We bring together Nordic nature and cutting-edge science to develop solutions that support gut health and barrier function.

Our flagship product, OatBiotics, is a unique postbiotic food made from microbially fermented oats. During fermentation, natural compounds are formed – including lactic acid and other short-chain fatty acids (SCFAs) – which can be further metabolized by the gut microbiota into butyrate, the most important energy source for the intestinal barrier.

Oats are also naturally rich in beta-glucans, fibers that stimulate butyrate production. Butyrate is essential for maintaining barrier integrity, supporting the immune system, and reducing low-grade inflammation, according to a growing body of scientific studies.

Research published in peer-reviewed journals has documented beneficial effects of ReFerm in both everyday gastrointestinal challenges, such as irritable bowel syndrome (IBS), and in advanced clinical research settings, including liver cirrhosis and ulcerative colitis.

Name: PlantGraph
Description:
PlantGraph — One Graph to Connect All of Plant Biology

Researchers spend a lot of time navigating fragmented databases. PlantGraph unifies 30+ authoritative sources — from genomics and proteomics to pathways and literature — into one AI-powered knowledge graph. Ask a question, get a grounded answer. In seconds, not weeks.

Built at the Umeå Plant Science Centre (UPSC), Sweden, PlantGraph connects 14.7 million biological entities through 49.7 million curated relationships across 76 entity types and 91 relationship categories. It integrates data from TAIR, UniProt, STRING, Plant Reactome, Expression Atlas, Europe PMC, and dozens more — harmonized, interlinked, and ready to query.

Our tool doesn't just search — it reasons. PlantGraph discovers hidden connections across genes, proteins, pathways, phenotypes, and publications that no single database could reveal alone. Researchers can cross-check paper claims against the knowledge base, explore regulatory networks, and generate evidence-backed hypotheses — all through natural language questions.

Stop searching. Start discovering.

 What PlantGraph offers:
• 30+ integrated plant biology databases in one place
• Ask research questions in plain English — get evidence-backed answers
• Cross-species knowledge graph (Arabidopsis, Populus, and expanding)
• Cross-check paper claims against curated biological evidence
• Discover hidden gene–pathway–phenotype connections across datasets
• Interactive knowledge graph exploration

 Team:

https://www.linkedin.com/in/mao-jian-feng-94783a70/

We at Colzyx believe that by developing WOUNDCOM, a bioactive wound dressing, we can address this emerging problem, contribute to a better quality of life and make a difference in the fight against multidrug-resistant bacteria. We are making use of the human body's own wound healing and antibacterial processes. We have identified, isolated and further developed key molecules from the human innate immune system that are produced in the natural wound healing process. The addition of these molecules in the form of WOUNDCOM to a wound, has been shown to accelerate the natural wound healing process and synergistically kill bacteria that invade the wound.

We are a life science-start-up that set out as a spin-off from SciLifeLab/Karolinska Institutet. Based on our work on microbial metadegradomics  we aim to increase  efficiency, safety and speed in the development of small molecules modulating the microbiome. Our technology provides  immediate information of the effect of new drug substances on the microbiome.

Currently, our team focus on the application of this technology to measure cellular growth at the molecular level and to speed up the diagnosis of phenotypic antimicrobial resistance .

OUR MISSION
The rapid emergence of antibiotic-resistant bacteria and multidrug-resistant pathogenic fungi pose a threat to global health. If no urgent actions are taken, by 2050, antimicrobial resistance (AMR) will cause an estimated loss of 10 million lives and $US100 trillion. Fast and accurate diagnosis of antimicrobial resistant strains is key to contain the rise of AMR, limit its spread and provide adequate treatment to patients.

At 3N Bio we work on the development quick and simple tests able to detect antimicrobial resistance independent of the drug resistance mechanism used. We aim to provide fast diagnosis for bacterial infections and provide actionable recommendation for antibiotic usage. Our final goal is to  accelerate diagnosis,  improve patient survival, and contribute to individualized and rational use of antibiotics.

Name: Ciprocity
Description:
Confocal fluorescence microscopy is the gold standard for imaging 3D samples such as organoids, spheroids or large tissue samples but the thickness of these samples leads to light absorption and scattering. This makes it hard to inspect images visually as we cannot differentiate between a lack of marker (e.g. a necrotic core) or light loss.

Our physics-based innovation measures the amount of absorption and scattering of both excitation and emission light. Using these measurements we can calculate the transmittance and correct for absorption and scattering in the sample to obtain a measure of the fluorophore concentration that is unaffected by the sample thickness, or which plane is being imaged.

Our solution allows, for the first time using confocal microscopy, measuring spatial differences in fluorophore concentration within and between organoids. Using this, we understand whether a lack of signal in the center of an organoid is due to a lack of fluorescent marker or simply an artifact from light not reaching the center of the organoid.

Takara Bio Europe is a member of the Takara Bio Group, a leading supplier of tools for life scientists worldwide. Name: Alligator Bioscience AB
Description:
Alligator Bioscience AB is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing tumor-directed immuno-oncology antibody drugs. Alligator’s portfolio includes several promising drug candidates, with the CD40 agonist mitazalimab as its key asset. Furthermore, Alligator is co-developing ALG.APV-527 with Aptevo Therapeutics Inc., several undisclosed molecules based on its proprietary technology platform, Neo-X-PrimeTM, and novel drug candidates based on the RUBYTM bispecific platform with Orion Corporation. Out-licensed programs include AC101/HLX22, in Phase 2 development, by Shanghai Henlius Biotech Inc. and an undisclosed target to Biotheus Inc.

Alligator ́s technology platform comprises the proprietary technologies ALLIGATOR-GOLD and FIND. ALLIGATOR-GOLD is a human antibody library containing more than 60 billion unique antibody fragments. FIND (Fragment Induced Diversity) is a molecular evolution technology for optimization of antibodies and other proteins.

Immunotherapy of cancer:
The immune system protects the body from attacks by pathogenic microorganisms (e.g. viruses and bacteria) and by cancer cells. Cancer cells usually evade the immune system, for example by producing immunosuppressive substances. Thus, although tumors often contain a large number of immune cells that should be able to attack the cancer cells, they are unable to do so due to the immunosuppression caused by the tumor. With immunotherapy, the ability of the immune system to fight cancer cells is improved in an effective manner, and the defense mechanisms used by the tumor are blocked or weakened. In addition, immune cells capable of destroying the cancer cells will survive in the body and thus protect it from metastases that may arise after treatment has ended. This "vaccination effect" is unique for immunotherapy.

Name: Atlas Antibodies
Description:

Name: Pelago Bioscience AB
Description:
At Pelago Bioscience, we’re here to help you make faster, better-informed decisions in drug discovery. In 2010, our founders began to develop our proprietary CETSA (Cellular Thermal Shift Assay) technology, publishing a seminal research paper in Science 2013. Since then, Pelago Bioscience has become the leading CRO providing actionable, biologically relevant insights at the pre-clinical stage.Unlike traditional methods, CETSA gives you a reliable picture of drug-target interactions, ensuring that what you see in cells translates to patients.
Our services rest on four pillars:
•	Certainty in Biological Relevance: CETSA’s physiological approach helps minimize late-stage risks.
•	Fast & Early Confidence: We deliver actionable insights in just 10 days-10 weeks (service dependent), eliminating unnecessary complexities so you can make decisions faster.
•	Insights & Progress: Our data supports compound prioritization and predicts future research steps, reducing project costs.
•	Extended Team Support: We work as your dedicated partner, designing fit-for-purpose studies that align with your goals.
With Pelago Bioscience, you gain more than just data; you gain a trusted partner in your discovery journey.

Name: Navinci
Description:
Navinci is a Swedish biotech company that specializes in developing innovative solutions for the study of protein interactions. With a focus and a strong legacy in the development of in situ proximity ligation assay technology, Navinci has established itself as a center of excellence in the field and has a broad portfolio of products that help researchers study protein interactions in depth. 

Our Naveni Proximity Ligation Technology is at the forefront of innovation within the field of spatial proteomics and allows for the detection and quantification of protein interactions and post-translational modifications in a manner that is both sensitive and specific. It provides researchers with a valuable tool for their studies and helps deepen the understanding of the interplay between proteins in their native environment. 

Our latest focus is on target-specific kits within immuno-oncology, which detect interactions such as PD1/PD-L1. These kits are designed to help researchers easily visualize the interactions between immune checkpoint proteins in immune and cancer cells and elucidate the role that interactions, rather than individual proteins, play in the development of cancer.  

By providing researchers with reliable and innovative tools for visualizing and interpreting protein interplay, Navinci pushes forward the understanding of cell biology and brings precision to spatial proteomics.

Description:

Its unique discovery engine uses programmable human cells to recreate and manipulate T cell immunity. Anocca operates an advanced research and development infrastructure, underpinned by a custom software ecosystem, AnoccaOS, and in-house cGMP manufacturing and process development facilities. Name: SIGRID
Description:
SIGRID Therapeutics is a metabolic health company developing gut-local technologies designed to reduce the metabolic impact of modern meals.
 
Powered by patented SiPore technology, SIGRID products work locally in the gastrointestinal tract, where precisely engineered pores interact with digestive enzymes involved in carbohydrate and fat digestion. By slowing the breakdown of nutrients during digestion, SiPore supports steadier post-meal patterns and improved metabolic stability over time. 
 
Our work is built on a simple idea: modern food environments deliver rapid metabolic load, creating repeated spikes and swings that place strain on the body long before disease is diagnosed. SIGRID focuses on meal-level input modulation, offering a non-systemic approach designed to complement lifestyle interventions and, in clinical contexts, sit alongside pharmacologic care.
 
Today, SIGRID collaborates with clinicians, researchers, and health innovators to help translate metabolic science into practical tools that support healthier patterns, one meal at a time.
 
Key focus areas:
• Post-meal metabolic stability
• Appetite and satiety support
• Gut-local, non-systemic technologies
