Description:
Genovis offers a unique range of rapid and easy to use enzymatic tools primarily for the biopharmaceutical industry. Available worldwide, these SmartEnzymesTM are supplied in innovative formats for the development, production and quality control of biological drugs such as monoclonal antibodies, ADCs, biosimilars and bispecifics. The Genovis SmartEnzymes are widely used for the digestion, de-glycosylation and conjugation of the target molecule and are an ideal companion to popular analytical techniques like LC-MS. Within the portfolio there are enzymes specific for:

IgG digestion - FabRICATORTM, FabALACTICATM, GingisKHANTM, FabULOUSTM & FabRICATOR ZTM
General proteolysis - GingisREXTM
De-glycosylation and conjugation of IgGs - GlycINATORTM, IgGZEROTM and GlyCLICKTM
O-glycan analysis - OglyZORTM, OpeRATORTM, GlycOCATCHTM and SialEXOTM

Name: Swedish Algae Factory
Description:
We produce uniquely functional materials that are good for the planet. 
Our mission is to be the world-leading producer of advanced materials from algae and a driving force towards a circular and bio-based industry. 

We are the first company in the world to cultivate and sell diatom algae shells. We call the material Algica. Algica is a porous silica with unique light altering, absorptive and binding properties that are unmatched by synthetic materials. 

Algica is today used as a top-performing and certified organic personal care ingredient. Products with Algica has today been launched in the Nordics, US and Australia. Read more about the use of Algica in personal care applications at www.algica.com

Algica can also make silicon solar panels at least 4% more efficient and DSSC 38% more efficient. Each kg Algica used in solar panels reduces C02 emissions with at leasts 200 tons according to WWF. 

The production is circular and we aim to make it as environmentally friendly as possible. The algae clean nutrient rich water from a land-based fish farm, and absorb CO2 and key nutrients that can be made into sustainable fish feed.

Name: Moleculent
Description: Moleculent’s platform detects cell-cell interactions directly within their native tissue environment. This makes it possible to see how healthy cells function, how diseased cells differ, and provides access to functional proteomics at scale. #cellcellcommunication

Name: Acrivon Therapeutics, Inc.
Description: Acrivon Therapeutics is a precision oncology therapeutics company uniquely enabled by a differentiated proteomics-based patient selection platform. Our method is widely applicable across drug classes and modalities. We specifically apply our approach to challenging oncology drug targets causally implicated in the vast majority of cancers, particularly those without simple single gene driver mutations or synthetic lethal contexts. Leveraging our unique patient selection platform, Acrivon Therapeutics aims to rapidly progress in-licensed clinical-stage assets and a pipeline of internally developed programs through accelerated registration trials. Acrivon Therapeutics and its clinical biomarker development group is headquartered in the greater Boston area, with biomarker discovery efforts concentrated in our wholly-owned subsidiary in Lund, Sweden.

Name: CCRM Nordic
Description:
The Centre for Commercialization of Regenerative Medicine (CCRM) Nordic is located at GoCo Health Innovation City in Mölndal, Gothenburg, Sweden with specialized infrastructure and expertise focused on development, manufacturing and commercialization of Advanced Therapy Medicinal Products (ATMPs).
ATMP is the European Medicines Agency (EMA) classification of cell and gene therapy drugs, and tissue engineered drugs. These products must be produced to Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) standards and complete clinical trials before applying for market approval and becoming available to patients. Organizations like CCRM ensure ATMPs are manufactured and controlled according to the required quality standards, strengthening the chances these novel therapeutics will make it to patients.
CCRM Nordic is a not-for-profit infrastructure for commercialization of advanced therapies, based on the successful CCRM model founded in Toronto, Canada and formed as a public private partnership backed by an industry consortium and the Swedish Innovation agency Vinnova.

Name: Ljusgårda AB
Description:
We take normal plants and make them Supernormal.

At Supernormal Greens, we develop active botanical ingredients by precisely controlling how plants grow, respond and express their biology.

By combining controlled environment agriculture, analytical tools and elicitation-driven optimization, we increase targeted plant compounds, reduce variability and create ingredients with consistent quality, full traceability and real commercial relevance.

Name: NextCell Pharma AB
Description:
NextCell Pharma is an innovative Biotech growing out of the need for Advanced Therapy Medicinal Products for Autoimmune Disease and Transplantation. Cellaviva, the first Swedish family saving stem cell bank, with its expertise in umbilical cord stem cells and Diamyd Medical with its interests and investments within autoimmune diseases made a natural partnership for creating NextCell Pharma. Clinical trials testing NextCell Pharma’s first product, ProTrans,has started in Novermber 2018.
#nextcellpharma #cellaviva

Name: Svar Life Science AB
Description:
For customers working in the life sciences and pharma industry, Svar offers a unique combination of scientific expertise, high-quality assay products, strong services, and proprietary technology platforms that provide a flexible, effective, and seamless experience for customers through different development needs in a way that no other single business can.

At Svar, we are dedicated to our customers' development journey. We harness a deep understanding and long-standing experience in immunological areas such as complement system activation and immunogenicity. We utilize this in our expert cell engineering, assay development, and contract research services capabilities. Our specialist knowledge allows us to help you tackle complex problems, safely and efficiently moving your candidates through the drug development phases and to the patient—also when standard solutions fall short.

Name: BiotechBikers
Description: Sealing the deal, finding the right collaborator, uncovering innovation - it's all about people and relationships. BiotechBikers brings together “bike-minded” life sciences and healthcare professionals in a unique community based around guided group rides, virtual meetups and other social events.

Name: Antaros Medical
Description:
Antaros Medical was founded in 2014, with a mission to deliver innovative imaging solutions for decision-making in drug development. This mission was and still remains driven by the huge unmet need for improved medicines and tools to support their development. 

To meet this need, we develop and tailor imaging solutions to help pharmaceutical companies understand how their drugs work in the human body. This gives our customers support to make decisions about how to progress with their drug development projects, and helps reduce the risk and cost of getting new medicines to patients. This is really the essence of why we exist. 

We have grown into a global company with over 150 employees, at our headquarters and our CoreLab imaging facility in Sweden, and our subsidiary in the US. We work primarily with metabolic diseases, such as diabetes, and diseases that affect the heart, liver and kidneys, and also in the oncology field.

The global clinical trials that we carry out range from small, early-stage studies to large, late-stage trials. We are proud to have worked with many of the big pharma and biotech companies and of our collaborations with academia.

Name: SciLifeLab Lund
Description: SciLifeLab is a national resource of unique technologies and expertise available to life scientists, closely intertwined with our community of researchers in areas such as biomedicine, ecology and evolution. We bring scientists together across traditional boundaries and foster collaborations with industry, health care, public research organizations and international partners.

Name: Symcel
Description:
All life is metabolically active. It produces heat – we measure it.

Symcel provides solutions for cell and microbial research and testing that enable versatile, rapid, sensitive, and automated detection, even in complex samples.

Based on isothermal microcalorimetry technology, the systems provide growth-based, label-free, and non-destructive testing of microbes and how cells respond to treatments. High-sensitivity metabolic detection accelerates testing and can deliver results long before visible growth or conventional readouts become available.

Applications include:
•	Rapid sterility testing of pharmaceuticals and cell and gene therapies
•	Rapid microbial testing of consumer goods and industrial formulations
•	Biofilm analysis using in situ models for infection, antimicrobial, and materials studies
•	Clinical microbiology research, including species detection and antimicrobial susceptibility testing
•	Food microbiology, enabling detection of microbial contaminants in complex food matrices
•	Environmental and microbiome in situ analysis of interactions in complex systems
•	Eukaryotic cell research, including metabolic activity studies in cancer, adipose, and embryo models

Symcel is headquartered at the Karolinska Institute in Stockholm and collaborates with leading academic institutions, therapy developers, test laboratories, and industry partners worldwide.

What’s your challenge? Let’s solve it together.

Visit symcel.com to learn more. Follow our page to stay informed about company updates, application insights, case studies, and career opportunities.

Name: Scantox Group
Description:
Scantox is a preclinical GLP-accredited CRO, specialized in providing services within the drug development process Discovery, Genetic Toxicology, Regulatory Toxicology and Pharmaceutical Development & Analytical.  Based on decades of experience, we are a trusted partner for CRO services for the pharmaceutical and medical devices industries. The Scantox Group is headquartered in Ejby, Denmark, with subsidiaries in UK, Austria, Denmark and Sweden (Lund and Gothenburg).

The Scantox services enable clients to progress their drug or device development based on solid data to the highest technical and scientific standards. The Scantox team is passionate about the common vision to improve the health of people, and all processes are rooted in dedication and guided by a strong sense of purpose.  

Founded in 1977, Scantox is today owned by the Nordic based investment company Impilo. Certified as a 2023 Great Place To WorkTM.

#pharmacology #toxicology #histopathology #pathology #minipigtoxicology #neuropharmacology #genotox

Name: Mendus AB
Description: Mendus is dedicated to changing the course of cancer treatment by addressing tumor recurrence and improving survival outcomes for cancer patients, while preserving quality of life. We are leveraging our unparalleled expertise in allogeneic dendritic cell biology to develop an advanced clinical pipeline of novel, off-the-shelf, cell-based immunotherapies which combine clinical efficacy with a benign safety profile. Based in Sweden and The Netherlands, Mendus is publicly traded on the Nasdaq Stockholm under the ticker IMMU.ST.

Name: Nordic Biosite
Description:
Nordic Biosite is an established growing company, representing top quality manufacturers of validated products for research and diagnostics. This includes areas such as, for example, neuroscience, stem cell and cancer research.

We represent the best manufacturers in the USA, Europe and Asia. Quality and a broad product range are important factors in our choice of manufacturers.

We want to facilitate your research. From Nordic BioSite you can expect a reliable, knowledgeable and trustworthy supplier who will guide you to the right products for your research and diagnostic needs. We constantly strive to be a better partner in your research.

Name: Umeå Biotech Incubator
Description:
Umeå Biotech Incubator (UBI) is a state-of-the-art biotech incubator that strives to transform ideas and innovations from academia and health care to real benefit for patients and society. 
In 2024 we were named one of "Europe's leading start-up hubs" by Financial Times. 

We do this by offering innovators a unique combination of lab facilities, business coaching, product development, team evaluation and professional expertise in acquisition of venture capital, IPR and marketing strategy.  

Although our office and facilities are located in the heart of northern Sweden - we evaluate ideas and projects from the whole country. Our closest partners comprise of Umeå University, Region Västerbotten (RV), Sveriges Lantbruksuniversitet (SLU), Norrlands Universitetssjukhus (NUS) and Försvarets forskningsinstitut (FOI).

Since the start in 2003, UBI has seen the start of more than 30 companies, and our projects have a high success rate for landing financial grants from VINNOVA and other external funding.

To make sure that you do not waste your time on an impossible project, we help you make those difficult decisions based on stop-and-go criteria. And when the time is right, we can coach you and your project prior to meetings with potential investors.

We take no part or have any claims on the companies and business projects that develop and grow under our roof. This is possible thanks to our owners, financiers and partners. Our success is measured by the success rate of the projects which we collaborate with.

Welcome to join our creative team at ubi.se

Name: Testa Center
Description: A test bed for biology and technology for production of biological products

Name: Cantargia AB
Description: Cantargia develops antibody based therapies against the target IL1RAP. The  two clinical programs are nadunolimab in phase II development for treatment of cancer, and CAN10 in phase I development for autoimmune/inflammatory diseases.

Name: BioInnovation
Description:
BioInnovation is an initiative with the vision that Sweden has a bio-based economy by 2050. The budget is planned at 50 MSEK per year. This will initially be financed by Vinnova, The Swedish Energy Agency and The Swedish Research Council Formas, as well as the participating organisations. 

The aim is to increase the value creation and competitiveness of the bio-based sector by creating the best possible conditions to produce new bio-based materials, products and services with a high value for customers, serving markets worldwide.

We gather ideas and the players who want to transform ideas into innovation.

Our work is currently concentrated to three prioritised areas
• Chemicals & Energy
• Materials
• Construction & Design.

Today, more than 50 organisations have joined BioInnovation, supporting the common vision and initiative.

The programme is open to all, if you want to get involved, please read more at: www.bioinnovation.se!

Name: Vironova BioAnalytics
Description:
Founded in Stockholm in 2005, Vironova is a world leading partner to the global life science community in the development of novel therapies for tomorrow. By combining hardware and software solutions for advanced electron microscopy analysis, we support our partners through the whole value chain. From initial sample preparation to imaging and final analytical result, our dedicated team provide insightful and actionable data. We empower clients to make better-informed decisions, to create value and ensure safety for patients worldwide.

TEM has previously been an expensive and complex practice to use in gene therapy, vaccine and drug development. At Vironova, we focus on supporting our partners by lowering technical thresholds, minimizing analytical complexity and provide business critical insights for the development of biopharmaceuticals targeting previously untreatable conditions. 

We are experts in what we do and put technology and innovation at our core. From initial sample preparation to imaging and final analytical result, our dedicated team will cut time and cost to market for our clients, and ultimately create value for patients worldwide. We are on a mission to build trust in the therapies of tomorrow by making the invisible visible today. 

Vironova provides fast and cost-effective electron microscopy services enabled by our own software and hardware. Our services are performed in the world’s only GMP-certified TEM laboratory, creating reliable and traceable results. This makes us the only company with a full-service value chain offer from start to finish.
By combining deep industry expertise and data-driven insights, we help clients solve real needs by making the subvisible accessible. With over 200 established customer relationships, Vironova is a leading partner for the life science industry. We have a strong acquisition pipeline of new clients and deep inroads with the global research community.

Name: Cavidi
Description:
Cavidi is a Swedish biotech firm that is transforming the field of biomarker detection with our groundbreaking solution, Exazym — the world’s first add-on reagent system that delivers ultra-sensitive detection of low-abundance biomarkers using standard immunoassay workflows.

Cavidi's products are used globally by biomedical scientists and researchers working on basic, transitional and pre-clinical biomarker research.

Name: Saveggy
Description: Saveggy’s plant-based protection helps growers, packers and retailers keep fresh produce longer and capture more value from every harvest, reducing food waste at scale.

Name: pixlbio
Description:
pixlbio is redefining predictive biology.

Formed from the merger of DefiniGEN (UK) and Phenaros (Sweden), we combine iPSC-derived human models with high-throughput imaging and AI-powered phenomics to uncover subtle cellular insights that animal models can’t.

Our platform captures millions of images and profiles hundreds of millions of cells each week, turning complex biology into predictive clarity for drug discovery and safety.

What we offer:
- iPSC-derived hepatocytes, stellates & intestinal organoids
- Validated disease models (MASLD/MASH, A1ATD, Wilson’s)
- AI-driven phenomics
- Proprietary automation and SaaS access

Trusted by 11 of the top 20 pharma companies, leading biotechs, and research institutions worldwide.

We’re ISO 9001:2015 certified and expanding into cardiac and renal models — building the next generation of predictive biology.

 Every cell tells a story. Every pixel holds a clue.

Name: Elypta
Description:
Elypta is a Swedish molecular diagnostics company focused on reducing cancer mortality through early detection. Elypta is pioneering a metabolism-based liquid biopsy and measures the GAGome – system biomarkers of tumor metabolism. Machine learning algorithms are then used to detect signatures of cancer noninvasively. Elypta is advancing a broad clinical program across different cancers with the first indication expected to be early detection of recurrence in renal cell carcinoma.

Several years of research in Nielsen lab at Chalmers University of Technology in Gothenburg, Sweden led to the founding of Elypta in May 2017 by Francesco Gatto and Jens Nielsen.

Name: Fluicell
Description: Fluicell is transforming how we treat disease with one-of-a-kind tissue solutions for regenerative medicine and drug screening. With the groundbreaking Nexocyte platform, based on twenty years of disruptive and patent-protected R&D, we are creating new ways to target serious diseases using precision-engineered biological tissues. Our transplantable tissues have the potential to help patients living with uncurable tissue damage related to cardiac, pulmonary, metabolic, kidney and other diseases. Fluicell’s first ambitious goal is to develop transplantable tissues to cure type 1 diabetes, impacting the lives of millions of patients. Nexocyte-generated tissues also enable our world-leading partners to advance their drug-screening capabilities for the development of game-changing medicines.

Name: Ramcon
Description:
Ramcon's mission is to combine global products and expertise with local knowledge in the Nordic countries.

Ramcon is a focused Nordic distributor. We strive to maintain a high, professional level. The company consists of competent and well-educated employees at offices in Sweden and Denmark. Our strength is knowing our customers' needs as well as a vast knowledge of the Industrial, Medical, Chemical and Life Science market in the Nordic countries.

Ramcon constantly strives to be an organisation characterised by a positive social atmosphere. We value integrity and respect for colleagues, customers and partners very highly. We invest in people as the primary marketing resource and offer a high level of service and support to our customers. It is the company's strategy to build good and lasting customer relations.

For more information or career opportunities please contact; ramcon@ramcon.dk or ramcon@ramcon.se.

Name: Single Technologies
Description: SINGLE TECHNOLOGIES develops a new type of single molecule sensitive 3D sequencing system.

Name: Kancera
Description:
Kancera is a clinical stage biotech developing a new class of small molecule drugs with an immune cell modulating mode-of-action with focus on cardiovascular diseases. The lead program KAND567 is in clinical phase II-stage and is aiming to prevent reperfusion injury that may occur in connection with percutaneous coronary intervention in acute myocardial infarction.
The stock is traded on the Nasdaq First North Premier Growth Market.

Name: Salipro Biotech AB
Description:
Making the undruggable druggable. 

Salipro Biotech AB is a privately held biotech company focused on unlocking challenging drug targets for the development of next-generation therapeutics. Headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden, the company collaborates with global pharma and biotech companies to accelerate the discovery of novel drugs. For our own pipeline, we are striving to develop drugs toward targets that no one could access before.
 
The majority of drug targets are so-called membrane proteins; however, these targets are inherently unstable and challenging to investigate. Our proprietary Salipro technology stabilizes membrane proteins in their native forms, enabling them to be employed in drug discovery programs for therapeutic antibodies, small molecule drugs and structure-based drug design.

Name: SciLifeLab National Genomics Infrastructure - NGI
Description: The National Genomics Infrastructure (NGI) is hosted by Science for Life Laboratory (SciLifeLab), a Swedish national center for molecular biosciences with a focus on health and environmental research.  NGI's mission is to operate a world-leading genomics infrastructure that provides state-of-the-art technology and expertise, drives technology development, and supports its users in applying genomics across the spectrum of life sciences.

Name: Elicera Therapeutics AB
Description: Elicera Therapeutics is a clinical stage cell and gene therapy company focusing on immunooncology. The company develops CAR T-cells against both solid and liquid tumors based on its proprietary technology platform, iTANK, for a parallell activation of an innate immune response against cancer. Elicera also develops next generation oncolytic viruses with three combined mode-of-actions, applicable for treatment of most cancers.

Name: Ridgeview Instruments AB
Description:
Ridgeview Instruments is a Swedish biotech company focused on providing instruments and software for studying biological interactions in real-time. Our cell-based interaction technology LigandTracer is used in over 25 countries worldwide and our analysis software TraceDrawer supports data analysis over many different instrument platforms.
 
Thorough characterization of interactions with cellular receptors is crucial for understanding biology, and targeting/monitoring diseases like cancer. With LigandTracer you can perform time-resolved cell based assays with minimal use of disposables and manual intervention. Common applications are binding assays of interactions such as ligand-receptor,  antibody-antigen, PET/SPECT tracer binding kinetics, and time-resolved viability assays. In addition, Ridgeview Instruments offers assay development services.

Name: Agteria
Description: Agteria is an AI discovery company for agriculture. We find novel solutions that solve the biggest unsolved problems in food production - and partner with the industry leaders who bring them to farms worldwide.

Name: Bioextrax AB
Description:
Bioextrax develops solutions for scalable and cost-efficient production of biobased and biodegradable materials. We provide patented biosolutions for converting renewable resources into high value materials, supporting the transition to a circular economy.

Our patented process enables efficient extraction of PHA granules (polyhydroxyalkanoates), which is a biobased and biodegradable plastic alternative made by microbes. PHAs are a family of bioplastics that can reduce the spread of microplastics and replace a wide range of fossil-based plastics. 

We also upcycle poultry feather waste into highly digestible protein hydrolysates for animal feed, creating value from an underutilised side stream in the poultry industry. In addition, we also extract keratin microfibers from the feathers which can be used in composites, insulation, filtration and textiles.

We provide scalable solutions, made by microbes.

Name: Genkyotex S.A
Description:
Genkyotex has become a wholly owned subsidiary of Calliditas and have been delisted from the Euronext stock exchanges. 

Genkyotex’s lead product candidate, setanaxib, is a first-in-class NOX inhibitor that targets NOX 1 and NOX 4, which are major drivers of fibrogenesis in multiple organs. In Q4 2021, Calliditas plans to initiate a 52-week, randomized, placebo-controlled, double-blind, trial with an adaptive phase 2b/3 design with setanaxib in 318 patients with primary biliary cholangitis (PBC). As previously announced in August 2021, Calliditas received FDA fast track designation for setanaxib in PBC. Calliditas will also initiate a Phase 2 proof-of-concept study in head and neck cancer in 2021, which will investigate the administration of setanaxib in conjunction with immunotherapy targeting cancer associated fibroblasts (CAFs).

Follow @Calliditas Therapeutics for updates on future developments: https://www.linkedin.com/company/calliditas-therapeutics/

Name: BioReperia AB
Description:
At BioReperia, we are transforming how cancer therapies are developed and personalized. With over 55 years of world-renowned combined experience in zebrafish tumor models, our team delivers deep scientific expertise through the ZTX platform – a rapid, highly translational, and CE-certified in vivo system that provides actionable results in just five days.

Backed by strong validation and trusted by pharma, biotech, and clinicians, ZTX offers a uniquely powerful, highly predictive, and cost-effective tool that provides high-resolution evaluation of tumor regression, metastasis inhibition, and immune interactions – using cell lines, PDX models, or patient-derived material. Whether you are developing small molecules or biologics, our platform empowers confident, data-driven decisions throughout the drug development pipeline.

ZTX PREDICT: Match patients with the most effective therapies to drive personalized oncology.
ZTX ONCOLEADS: Accelerate early discovery and strengthen preclinical programs with rapid, translatable efficacy data.

By bridging human tumor biology with the speed and precision of ZTX we help reduce R&D attrition, cut timelines, and increase clinical success.

Join us in bringing better cancer treatments to patients faster!

Get in touch at info@bioreperia.com | www.bioreperia.com

Name: Xintela AB
Description: Xintela develops medical products in stem cell therapy and targeted cancer therapy based on the Company's cell surface marker integrin α10β1 which is found on mesenchymal stem cells and on certain aggressive cancer cells. The stem cell marker is used to select and quality-assure the patent-protected stem cell product XSTEM, which is in clinical development for treatment of knee osteoarthritis and difficult-to-heal leg ulcers. The company produces XSTEM for the clinical studies in its GMP-approved manufacturing facility. In cancer therapy, which is run by the wholly owned subsidiary Targinta AB, therapeutic antibodies, targeting integrin α10β1 (First-in-Class) are being developed for the treatment of triple-negative breast cancer and the brain tumor glioblastoma.

Name: Cellevate AB
Description:
Cellevate develops and markets products based on a proprietary nanofiber-based platform - the Cellevat3dTM - with the potential to revolutionize upstream bioprocessing from R&D to commercial manufacturing. Our latest product line in development – Cellevat3dTM carriers – with a commercial launch planned for 2024, provides extracellular-like environments with exceptional surface areas for adherent cell cultures. Initial results show tremendous potential to increase yields, minimize risk and reduce costs in development and manufacturing.

We offer a range of products based on our versatile and easily functionalized platform for several applications, including next generation cell- and gene therapies.

For more information, please visit www.cellevate.com

Name: Intellego Technologies
Description: Intellego Technologies is a rapidly growing research and development company. Intellego’s main goal is to develop its patented dosimeter technology, which can indicate when radiation or substances are present. The dosimeter technology involves a photochromic ink which changes color when exposed to a certain level of radiation or certain substances. The application areas are widespread, and Intellego is today working with products for use in the consumer, hospital and construction industries. In addition, Intellego has several development projects for other applications in its pipeline. Intellego’s products are sold in 15 countries worldwide.

Name: Moligo Technologies
Description:
We developed a new technology for enzymatic production of high quality, long and even functionalized DNA molecules, which will have a huge impact on industrial synthetic biology, precision diagnostics, therapeutics and nanotechnology. 
DNA oligonucleotides are commonly synthesized by solid phase, but after decades of fine-tuning and improvements in liquid handling, the upper limit of phosphoramidite-based oligo synthesis is now about 200-300 nucleotides, with further limitations in terms of purity and efficacy in presence of strong secondary structures or repeats.
The advances and improvements in diagnostic and therapeutic systems based on nucleic acids are leading to a big and urgent need of highly pure and long DNA strands, and Moligo Technologies mission is to satisfy this necessity. In fact, thanks to our know-how, and to the capacity of experienced scientific and executive team, we are already able to synthesize, and very soon commercialize, single stranded oligonucleotides of thousands of bases with purity of about 99.9%.

Name: MedTalks with Kathrin
Description:
MedTalks with Kathrin is a podcast connecting the worlds of clinical research, healthcare, and patient communication. Hosted by Clinical Trial Communication Strategist and medical communicator Kathrin Kunze, the show explores how complex medical topics – from oncology and rare diseases to clinical trials – can be communicated clearly and effectively to both healthcare professionals and patients.

The podcast bridges the gap between industry and patient perspectives, providing practical insights, expert interviews, and real-world strategies that resonate across multilingual audiences.

Why Sponsors Partner with MedTalks:

MedTalks reaches a growing audience of healthcare professionals, researchers, and decision-makers in clinical trials, pharmacy, and life sciences. 

Sponsors benefit from:

Targeted exposure to a highly engaged professional audience
Alignment with content that prioritizes clear, patient-centered communication
Opportunities for thought leadership and industry partnerships

Join us on MedTalks to engage with an informed, international community and position your organization at the forefront of meaningful healthcare communication.

Name: Planetary Biology at SciLifeLab
Description:
The Planetary Biology Strategic Area at SciLifeLab is motivated by a need for coordinated & transdisciplinary efforts to understand Earth’s biodiversity, from single molecules and cells to individual species, communities, ecosystems, and their functioning on the planet. 
By leveraging SciLifeLab’s comprehensive technology portfolio and resources, the Strategic Area aims to:
* Accelerate and support research from single molecules to ecosystem and planetary scales.
* Connect and empower a multidisciplinary research community to tackle crucial challenges in ecology, conservation, evolution, and biogeochemistry.
Follow us to stay updated on our latest research and initiatives!

Name: Strike Pharma AB
Description: Strike Pharma is using its proprietary technology  for targeted  nanoparticle delivery to enable in vivo CAR-T therapy. The lead candidate, STR3/19, is based on a lipid nanoparticle that carries mRNA for an anti-CD19 CAR that is selectively delivered to T cells via an anti-CD3 antibody. This is an off-the-shelf alternative to current CAR-T therapies, that reprogrammes T cells to B-cell depleting CAR-Ts inside the body and that is intended for treatment of B-cell dependent autoimmune disease, such as SLE, and for B-cell lymphoma. Strike Pharma was founded in 2020, has Eir Ventures and Flerie Invest as major shareholders, and is headquartered at Smile Venture Hub, Medicon Village, Lund, Sweden.

Name: AnoxKaldnes
Description:
Wastewater treatment with microorganisms
 
The market leading AnoxKaldnesTM MBBR (Moving Bed Biofilm Reactor) technology is based on the biofilm principle and is used for biological wastewater treatment. Microorganisms grow on small specially designed plastic carriers that are kept suspended in a reactor. 

Solutions based on AnoxKaldnesTM MBBR technology offer numerous benefits, such as robust biofilm, flexible reactor design, easy upgrade of existing plants, easy to operate and control, no sludge return needed in most applications, low load on particle separation stage.

A part of Veolia Water Technologies

AnoxKaldnes is a part of Veolia Water Technologies. With a worldwide network of experts, Veolia Water Technologies provides a complete range of services required to design, build, maintain and upgrade water and wastewater treatment facilities for industrial clients and public authorities.

Name: SARomics Biostructures AB
Description:
SARomics Biostructures offers top-rated custom X-ray crystallography services, including protein and protein-ligand complex crystallization, and gene-to-protein structure determination. Our library of FastLane Standard and FastLane Premium off-the-shelf structures comprises over 600 constructs, ready to be expressed, purified, and crystallized according to verified protocols. Our team also benefits from extensive experience in antibody & antibody-antigen 3D structure determination and higher order structure (HOS) comparability analysis of biosimilars.

Protein NMR spectroscopy services include:
- Peptide and protein NMR assignment
- Structure determination of proteins and their complexes
- Protein-ligand and protein-protein complex structure determination
- Fragment screening using 1D and 2D NMR spectroscopy
- Epitope mapping
- Determining dissociation constants (Kd) for compounds
- Verification of higher order structure (HOS) for biosimilars and comparability analysis
- Characterization and optimization of formulation

Our integrated drug discovery services include:
- Proprietary weak affinity chromatography (WAC) fragment screening. 
- Crystallographic and NMR fragment screening.
- Proprietary fragment libraries for WAC and crystallographic fragment screening.
- Computational chemistry services, including virtual screening, pharmacophore-based screening, and much more. 

Why choose SARomics Biostructures:
- Quick responses to all contact requests. We set realistic project timelines after the initial discussion.
- We guarantee high-quality services and a high degree of customer satisfaction.
- Our robust technology platform is built around a wide variety of experimental methods.
- Located in Medicon Village in Lund with proximity to one of the world's best synchrotrons, MAX IV Laboratory.

Name: Abliva AB
Description: Abliva discovers and develops medicines for the treatment of mitochondrial disease. This rare and often very severe disease occurs when the cell’s energy provider, the mitochondria, do not function properly. The company has prioritized two projects. KL1333, a powerful regulator of the essential co-enzymes NAD+ and NADH, has entered late-stage development. NV354, an energy replacement therapy, has completed preclinical development. Abliva is based in Lund, Sweden.

Name: Gedea Biotech AB
Description:
Modern, antibiotic free treatment of vaginal infections


Founded in 2015 in Lund, Sweden, Gedea Biotech is dedicated to developing safe and effective, antibiotic-free treatments for vaginal infections. Our lead product pHyph is an antibiotic free treatment for bacterial vaginosis that strengthens the healthy vaginal microbiome, supporting good vaginal health also in the long term. pHyph is approved for CE-mark has under EU MDR since 2025. The approval demonstrates the efficacy and safety of pHyph in treating bacterial vaginosis. 
We want to launch pHyph in partnership with pharmaceutical companies established in women’s health. pHyph is launch ready in Europe and in the US we want to enter a partnership for remaining clinical studies and launch.

Name: SOMA Genomics
Description:
SOMA Genomics develops compound companion diagnostics (SOMA-CDxTM) designed to match therapies to the true biological state of the tumor.

Current precision oncology diagnostics often rely on isolated biomarkers that provide only a partial view of treatment-relevant biology. SOMA’s approach instead integrates multiple clinically relevant molecular signals within a defined therapeutic context to support more reliable treatment decisions.

Our platform is designed to capture biologically relevant interactions between drivers, co-drivers, resistance mechanisms, and therapeutic chokepoints using DNA-, RNA-, and protein-level information within a unified diagnostic framework.

SOMA Genomics focuses on enabling next-generation precision oncology therapies, including targeted, RNA-based, and other mechanism-driven treatment modalities that require more precise patient stratification than conventional diagnostics can provide.

The company builds on prior translational oncology and diagnostics development efforts spanning liquid biopsy, molecular stratification, and therapy-linked precision medicine initiatives.

The company combines translational oncology, molecular diagnostics, and healthcare-system alignment to develop clinically usable, scalable, and regulatory-aligned companion diagnostics within EU IVDR and FDA frameworks.

Based at KI Science Park in Stockholm, SOMA Genomics collaborates with therapy developers, researchers, and clinical stakeholders to advance biologically grounded precision oncology.

Vi är en Lund-baserad startup som erbjuder bolag inom återvinningsindustrin

Enzymer bryter ner plast till dess beståndsdelar i två enkla steg utan lösningsmedel och höga temperaturer, vilket gör enzymatisk plaståtervinning till en konkurrenskraftig teknik med minskad energiförbrukning och minskat beroende av olja för att göra ny plast.

Plastavfall är ett stort problem världen över – endast ca 10 % av all plast som produceras idag återvinns. Blandad plast är ett särskilt stort problem då hela plasten idag bränns, även om det finns delar av plasten som skulle kunna återvinnas. Eftersom enzymer är specifika för en viss plast kan blandat plastavfall återvinnas, vilket inte är möjligt med endast kemiska metoder.
Cyclezyme har utvecklat enzymer vilka är termostabila, vilket möjliggör att effektivt bryta ner plast vid temperaturer över 70 grader. Återvinning av mer plast kommer minska utsläppen av växthusgaser och förorening av land och hav.

Our services are based around a well established 3D primary human liver spheroid culture platform developed at Karolinska Institutet. We offer in-house evaluations of drug metabolism, pharmacokinetic properties and safety as well as drug target validations. 

The platform is the most extensively characterized 3D spheroid system available, offering unmatched predictive accuracy. The key attributes are:

•	Physiologically replicative in vitro system with close resemblance to human liver on transcriptomic, proteomic and metabolomic level.
•	Optimized to support co-cultures with non-parenchymal cells, such as Kupffer, biliary, and Stellate cells.
•	Functionally stable and suitable for chronic applications, thus allowing to assess long-term toxicity, pharmacokinetics and chronic drug response, not supported by conventional in vitro systems.
•	Easy manipulation of gene expression through knockdown or knockin techniques.
•	Emulation of human inter-individual variability in an in vitro setting. 
•	High-throughput compatibility and scalability allows screening of hundreds of conditions and/or drug candidates with multiple replicates, adding to statistical power.
•	Controlled, chemically defined experimental conditions ensure maximal reproducibility.
•	Direct translation of findings to patients by using patient derived cells instead of cell lines or animal models.

Name: NORDVASC3D
Description:
The development of advanced 3D tissue models that replicate human physiology is a rapidly evolving field with profound implications for translational medicine. However, a key limitation in current in vitro systems is the lack of functional vascularization, which restricts tissue viability, complexity and clinical relevance. The proposed initiative, NORDVASC3D (Nordic Research Network on Vascularized 3D Organ-on-Chip Systems), brings together leading Nordic researchers and infrastructures to address this gap by integrating vascularized tissue engineering with organ-on-chip technologies.

By combining interdisciplinary expertise in microfluidics, stem cell biology and biomaterials, NORDVASC3D aims to engineer dynamic, perfusable 3D microenvironments that mimic key physiological and pathological processes. These platforms will allow for more predictive disease modeling, including cancer, neurodegenerative, cardiovascular and metabolic disorders, while enabling human-relevant drug screening and mechanistic studies with minimal reliance on animal models.

The initiative will leverage the unique strengths of the Nordic region, including strong traditions in collaborative biomedical research, harmonized ethical frameworks and cutting-edge national infrastructures for cell and tissue engineering. Moreover, it will foster cross-border knowledge exchange, open data practices and sustainable innovation.

Through coordinated research, joint training activities and summer school, NORDVASC3D will establish a Nordic research innovation hub for functional vascularized organ-on-chip systems. This will strengthen the region’s contribution to European priorities, such as reducing animal experimentation and enhancing the human relevance of biomedical research. Ultimately, this network will advance the development of next-generation translational tools for diagnostics, therapeutics and personalized medicine.

Name: Bio4Comp – Parallel Network-Based Biocomputation
Description:
Biocomputers are expected to be the future of computing, potentially being more economical and energy efficient. We are one of the international initiatives working to make it a reality. 
The idea behind Bio4Comp, an EU-funded research project, is that biomolecular machines, each only a few billionth of a meter (nanometers) in size, can solve problems by moving through a nanofabricated network of channels designed to represent a mathematical algorithm. We call our approach "network-based biocomputation".
Whenever the biomolecules reach a junction in the network, they either add a number to the sum they are calculating or leave it out. That way, each biomolecule acts as a tiny computer with processor and memory. While an individual biomolecule is much slower than a current computer, they are self-assembling so that they can be used in large numbers, quickly adding up their computing power. Members of the Bio4Comp team have recently demonstrated that this approach works not only in theory but also in practice.
Bio4Comp has two main goals: 
(i) Develop the technology required to scale up network-based biocomputers to a point at which they are able to compete with other alternative computing approaches such as DNA computing and quantum computing. 
(ii) Build a larger scientific and economic community that will focus on developing the technology into a viable alternative computing approach.

Name: LTH Profile Area Engineering Health
Description: The LTH Profile Area Engineering Health is a network of academic research groups at Lund University, Sweden. It encompasses several faculties (Medical, Engineering, Science) and has over 200 members who are either professors, PhD students, postdocs, teachers, or technicians. Engineering Health has the following subdivisions, called Focus Areas: Biomaterials and Biomechanics, Biomedical Imaging, Digital and Data-driven Health, Micro- and Nanobiotechnology, and Biomolecular and Cellular Technology.

Name: Richter Life Science
Description:
Our technology:
 
Optotracing is a sensor technology for detection and quantification of carbohydrates in their native form. These macromolecules are fundamental in all life forms on Earth, making Optotracing widely applicable in multiple sectors, including, but not limited to: 
 
- Bacterial detection in food and cleaning industries
- Infection/biofilm detection in wounds and clinical settings
- Structural mapping and quantification of carbohydrates in bio-based materials
- Quality control (e.g. cellulose quantification) in the wood/pulp/paper industry
 
Our company:
 
Richter Life Science is a Swedish company with its foundation in interdisciplinary research at Karolinska Institutet and  KTH Royal Institute of Technology in Stockholm and Linköping University.

Name: Lab on a Bead AB
Description:
Lab on a Bead is a Swedish biotech company focusing on the development, manufacture and sales of the next generation high-capacity magnetic separation platform for purification of biomolecules.

The LOABeads magnetic beads combine the high binding capacity of agarose with fast magnetic separation.

The concept for medium scale magnetic separation take the simplicity of magnetic separation from small laboratory scale to preparation scale.

You will find more information about our technology and our products on our website.

Name: AcouSome
Description:
Exosomes are nano-sized vesicles released by different cell types, that can be found in the blood and other body fluids. They are intensely researched as carriers of biomarkers for a wide range of diseases, including cancer and cardiovascular diseases. Investigating these tiny vesicles in blood is currently a tedious and inefficient process, and the lack of a feasible and standardized solution for separation of exosomes from blood has hindered exosome biomarker discovery, validation and translation of research in any blood-based diagnostics to-date. The goal of AcouSome project is to develop a miniaturized microfluidic module for exosome isolation directly from blood using ultrasound generated by thin films, to be used across wide research and next generation diagnostics applications.

AcouSome is a project funded by the European Union.

Name: Moleculink
Description:
Moleculink delivers molecular solutions for measuring proteins, nucleic acids and small molecules in diverse array of biological materials. Our patent estate and associated know-how provides valuable opportunities for in situ detection, mainly by microscopy but also on arrays, on western blots, and by flow cytometry.

Moleculink, formerly Olink Bioscience, has a strong track record for premiere in situ assays and broader offerings that combines in solution and in situ analysis of tissues. Moleculink licenses IP and partners with many companies to solve challenging biological questions with world class molecular technologies.

Name: Swedish Medical Nanoscience Center
Description: The Swedish Medical Nanoscience Center at Karolinska Institutet is uniquely positioned within the medical faculty where medical problems guide the nanoscience development within a setting that offers a blend of technological, pre-clinical and clinical expertise.The Swedish Medical Nanoscience Center will act as a knowledge hub on the national and international arena, forming a physical platform where scientists from the fields of medicine and engineering intimately collaborate in real life. This will foster a new breed of scientists with true interdisciplinary knowledge.

Name: Nordic BioConsult AB
Description: At Nordic BioConsult AB, we specialize in delivering expert consulting, efficient project management, and innovative method development to accelerate biotechnology research and its real-world applications.

Name: Immune Therapy Holdings
Description:
ITH is a biotech company located at the Karolinska Institutet and Karolinska University Hospital, dedicated to innovating the next generation of personalized therapeutics and diagnostics for patients with immune related diseases.

The company's research & development is focused on its award-winning Tailored Leukapheresis (TLA) immunotherapy for Immune Mediated Inflammatory Diseases - which has been developed with the support of the European Union, Swedish Research Council, and Swedish Governmental Agency for Innovation Systems.

Name: KLife Solutions LLP
Description:
KLife Solutions offering tailor-made high end services for biotech, pharmaceutical, academic and medical Industries. The company offers a platform for drug and technology development, preclinical testing and clinical trials.

K-Life Solutions also provides state-of-the-art bioinformatics and bio statistics analyses of various clinical and non-clinical data sets. Our teams of life science professionals enhance your ability to organize, perform analyses and discover new insights into various areas of biomedical research.

Disruptive technologies that shape markets, spanning from the consumer, wellness, technology and the medical sectors, and with a particular emphasis on AI.

Name: MedicWave AB (publ)
Description:
MedicWave is a Swedish software company that develops cutting-edge tools for quantitative analysis of mass spectrometry data. We have focused on meatabolomics and proteomics data exploration.

MedicWave is company that gathers enthusiasts in the fields of proteomics, mathematics, informatics, and biomedical engineering.

Recently we have developed SPECTROLYZER - new biomarker discovery software. But how is it different from other software platforms? Spectrolyzer uses advanced statistics to get reproducible results. This leads straight forward to reliable findings. 

Spectrolyzer is also very flexible. It enables you to export (and import) the data at any stage of processing and further analyze them using other tools like R or Matlab.

If you would like to find out more about Spectrolyzer's features and how it supports biomarker discovery, please visit our website.

Name: Avalance
Description: Avalance Biotech AB is high-tech company producing and developing research instruments for biotechnology, chemistry and medicine. Our main product is the Multifunctional Pipette - a targeted microfluidics based solution delivery tool for single-cell studies.

Name: AmbioGen
Description:
Ambiogen is a Stockholm-based sequencing service provider, spun out from the Center for Translational Microbiome Research at Karolinska Institutet. We specialize in metagenomics and other complex sample types.
Our background is in running large-scale, clinically anchored studies—so we know where projects usually go wrong. That’s why we start with a free consultation, before any samples are processed, to figure out if sequencing is even the right approach for your question. If it is, we design a strategy around your biology, your budget, and what you actually need from the data.

We handle everything in-house: automated extraction, automated library prep, sequencing, and full quality control with documented traceability for every sample. Low-biomass samples, complex matrices, international shipments—we’ve done it all. 

What makes us different is our high throughput capacity, automated workflow, high quality sequencing and complete transparency. You get a clear plan upfront, documented QC with every delivery, and a partner who will tell you when a simpler approach works just as well.

Name: CarryGenes
Description:
The next major breakthrough in Immuno-oncology
With a proprietary human synthetic chromosome (hSynC) as a carrier for antitumoral factors (OncoSynC) introduced into the patient’s own T-cells, CarryGenes’ Cromo-T will create a state of long-term vaccination against the patient’s tumor using immune cells loaded with an enhanced tumor-killing capacity. 

With a passion for science CarryGenes merges technologies as well as expertise in immunotherapy and chromosome bioengineering to produce a novel therapeutic with advanced safety mechanisms

With a lifelong passion for science and improving human health, the team has a joint ambition to use their knowledge to improve human health. Today there are no similar solutions to fight cancer.

Name: Oscillution
Description:
We are a service company that supports pharmaceutical and biotech companies in the discovery and development of drugs for neurological and neuropsychiatric diseases.

By replicating human brain electrical function in vitro, we provide high-capacity solutions that improve the understanding of how drug targets, lead compounds, and therapies impact human brain function.

We utilize 96-well with microelectrode array within each well to record the full spectrum of electrical signals generated in vitro from human brain cells we make.

Through our advanced in vitro discovery and testing platform, we aim to ensure that the effects of every drug on brain function are fully understood before any human treatment.

Name: Nordic Molecular Solutions
Description:
Nordic Molecular Solutions is a Sweden-based molecular biology and bioinformatics service provider supporting research, biotechnology, and life science innovation through high-quality, traceable laboratory workflows.
Located in Uppsala, one of Europe’s leading life science clusters, we partner with biotech companies, universities, CROs, and R&D teams to deliver reliable molecular processing and data analysis services that accelerate scientific progress.

Our core services include:
• DNA extraction

We operate under strict SOP-driven workflows to ensure reproducibility, traceability, and consistent quality across every project.
Our mission is to provide flexible, dependable molecular outsourcing solutions that allow research teams to scale efficiently, reduce turnaround time, and focus on discovery.

Name: BioChromix AB
Description:
Our goal is to become a leading diagnostic player within selected neurodegenerative diseases through the development of the unique BCX compounds. BioChromix current focus is in vitro and in vivo diagnostics of Alzheimer’s disease. Alzheimer’s disease affects nearly 1 % of the world population. It is a progressive, degenerative, irreversible disease, and the most common form of dementia. The only reliable diagnosis of Alzheimer’s disease that we have today is post mortem identification of the disease in the brain. 
The Company's vision is to offer products that enable optimal drug development, patient selection in clinical trials and early disease detection. Main products in development:
1. World class molecular imaging of Alzheimer’s disease (AD) 
2. Breakthrough in vitro assays and diagnostics analyzing the oligomeric Amyloid-β (Aβ) biomarker for AD
The company protects its technology through an extensive patent portfolio. For more information please visit: www.biochromix.com

Name: TopSpecMS
Description:
The TopSpec project will develop a ground-breaking TOP-down tandem mass SPECtrometry (MS/MS) platform with focus on antibody profiling. One major innovation is the novel radical gas-phase ion-electron and ion-atom reactions. Another “killer innovation” is the method to greatly simplify MS/MS spectra of large molecules by adding another dimension of separation – collisional cross-sections of fragment ions, using two parallel innovative approaches. TopSpec will pioneer the deconvolution of massively overlapping isotopic clusters, solving one of the greatest challenges in top-down MS/MS of large molecules, the analysis of protein variants (proteoforms ).
In this project, key experts in radical-assisted sequencing of proteins team up with the best developers in ultrahigh-resolution MS and MS/MS, as well as top European scientists in online protein separation and MS data processing. Achieving the seemingly impossible, we plan to create, test and validate a seamless platform capitalizing on our ground-breaking innovations, enable scientists from academia and industry to explore the antibody repertoire, enhancing our ability to explore new effective cures for major global diseases.

Name: Agri PAC World
Description:
Agri PAC World is a Swedish and South African agri-biotech company that develops products to help farmers transition to a more efficient and eco-sustainable agriculture. We focus on two key challenges in modern farming:

∞ Overuse of synthetic nitrogen
Synthetic nitrogen fertilisers are overused due to their inefficiency, raising costs for farmers while damaging the environment. 

∞ Decline of soil fertility 
Synthetic and mineral fertilisers don’t contain organic matter, such as humic substances, which are necessary for a healthy and fertile soil.

Agri PAC World has developed a groundbreaking technology that binds cheap synthetic urea to humic acids to produce green nitrogen, the ultimate slow release fertiliser. 

Additionally, we combine this technology with our partner company Ecofarma’s humic substances, which are uniquely rich in bio-stimulants. Through this combination we can produce a series of high-quality products for every soil and crop.

Agri PAC World also sells a toolkit with which farmers themselves can produce green nitrogen from urea and any humic acid. 

Learn more about our company on our website agripacworld.com.

It includes information on gene characteristics, such as functional and biological functions and disease associations. All this information is available to the research community, legislators, regulators, and the general public, making AddCell a valuable resource for anyone interested in CRISPR-edited cell lines.

Essum AB, founded 1989 in Umeå has done research, development, clinical studies and production of probiotics for Functional Foods, Food Supplements, Medical Devices and Pharmaceuticals.
